title: Thermally cleaning a filter nozzle using a Fluidized Bath
description:
Watch how a filter nozzle is thermally cleaned using an Accuthermal fluidized bath. Fluidized baths provide uniform heat transfer and controlled high-temperature cleaning for removing polymers, plastics, resins, oils, and organic buildup from metal parts.
This process is commonly used for cleaning industrial components such as filter nozzles, spinnerets, extrusion tooling, dies, and other heat-resistant metal parts.
Accurate Thermal Systems manufactures fluidized temperature baths, thermal cleaning systems, dry block calibrators, and NIST-traceable temperature calibration equipment.
Learn more: https://accuthermal.com
